description: Read the approved snapshot for one Pathrule skill. Use this after pathrule_get_context, pathrule_goto, or pathrule_get_node returns a skill_id. Returns the cloud SKILL.md content for the AI to follow; it does not install or materialize files locally.

skill_id.description: Skill UUID returned by pathrule_get_context, pathrule_goto, or pathrule_get_node.

name: pathrule_read_skill

content.description: Full SKILL.md body, including its frontmatter.

error.description: Present only when ok is false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, for example insufficient_scope, workspace_id_required, rate_limited, not_found, or upstream_error. Branch on this, not on message text.

detail.description: Optional structured context for the failure, for example { missing_scopes: [...] } on insufficient_scope.

node_path.description: Workspace-relative path the skill is attached to.

ok.description: true when the call succeeded. false when it did not, in which case `error` carries the reason and the success fields are absent.

source.description: One of manual, template, or github_ref.

version_id.description: Optimistic-concurrency token. Pass it as expected_version_id to pathrule_update_skill.

title: Read Skill
